description: This Java class represents user login credentials within the OpenMRS framework, including password management, secret questions, and audit information for password changes.

classes.name: LoginCredential
classes.description: Represents login credentials for a user, including hashed password, salt, secret questions, and change auditing.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who changed the password or credentials.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who changed the credentials.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the credentials were last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date of the last change.

methods.name: getSalt
methods.description: Returns the salt used for hashing the password.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with these credentials.

methods.name: getSecretAnswer
methods.description: Returns the secret answer for password recovery.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Checks if the provided plaintext password matches the stored hashed password.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this object, mapped to userId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this object, mapped to userId.
